title.zh: 测量留档脚本与取样结论修正
title.en: Evidence archive and a corrected sampler conclusion

intent.zh: 用户看不到我的测量过程，要求把截图 / 命令 / 中间 JSON 全部留档到 tests 下并按时间分目录；同时 --keep-image 必须存原始像素。顺带修正两处：① 早先"最近邻比双线性准"的测量把光标噪声算了进去——把光标挪出区域后重测两遍（结果逐字相同），取样方式在真实语料上没量出差别（双线性 10/10、最近邻 9/10）；② 新发现：光标进画面会让整行读崩（84.7 → 49.8），区域高度不足也会（400x20 → 乱码）。
intent.en: The user could not see my measurements and asked for every screenshot, command and intermediate JSON to be archived under tests/ in timestamped folders; --keep-image must save the raw pixels. Two corrections came with it: the earlier nearest-beats-bilinear measurement had caret noise in it - with the caret moved out and the battery run twice (identical results) the samplers show no measurable difference (bilinear 10/10, nearest 9/10); and a new finding: a caret inside the region makes the engine misread the whole line (84.7 -> 49.8), as does a region too short for the line box (400x20 -> garbage).

acceptance: tests/evidence.ps1 落盘：commands.txt（含 stderr）、json/、images/、summary.md，按时间戳分目录
--keep-image 存原始像素（尺寸 = 区域尺寸），--keep-prepared 存送进引擎的图
summary.md 复现两遍结果一致，且含光标对照（84.7 vs 49.8）与区域高度对照
note: 新增 tests/evidence.ps1（按时间戳把命令 / JSON / 截图 / 汇总留档）与 keymouse.tests.evidence 模块；--keep-image 改成存原始像素并新增 --keep-prepared；取样结论按重测结果修正（取样方式无差别），并把"光标进区域会让整行读崩""区域高度不足会切字"两条实测教训写进文档与模块说明。
